# Why this file exists: CMF's *_is_active registry pattern is meant for exactly two declarations: CMF itself (always = no) and the detected mod (always = yes). _grey_soft_pop declares is_usfp_active = no as a defensive fallback for when Hail Columbia isn't installed, with no idea where it sits relative to Hail Columbia in the load order -- and the whole Grey's pack loads after the whole HC+GoB+MoH block, so its REPLACE_OR_CREATE wins outright and Hail Columbia is switched off entirely: every is_usfp_active = yes gate inside it goes false, silently, with nothing in error.log.
